title: Magnetic column gutters and density choreography for high-cardinality tables
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Introduce a set of interaction patterns and visual tokens for 'magnetic' column gutters and density choreography that improve perceived and actual performance of our virtualized table. Goals: reduce accidental column drags, make resizing feel immediate even under progressive rendering, provide clear affordances for density changes (compact/comfortable/expanded), and ensure accessibility (keyboard-first resizing and ARIA announcements). This ticket covers the design spec, interaction prototypes, accessibility requirements, and handoff assets for engineering and QA.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Visual spec and tokens checked into Figma with compact/comfortable/expanded density states and explicit gutter focus styles.
2) Interaction prototype demonstrating magnetic gutter snaplines, column collapse animation, and keyboard drag handles.
3) Accessibility doc with keyboard flows and ARIA live-region copy.
4) Performance guidance: initial visible rows render within 200ms on typical laptop profile and no scroll jank > 10ms for 2000-row table during user-driven resize.
5) Handoff artifacts: PR template, implementation notes, and two example variants (multi-column pivot, sparse wide table) linked in the handoff doc.
design_notes: 2025-02-13: Kickoff workshop with PM (Liam Chen) and Eng (Sofia Park). Decided to favor small animated transitions for column collapse rather than instant jumps to avoid layout thrash.

2025-02-18: Explored three magnetism models: fixed snappoints, proximity-based easing, and velocity-based rebound. Chosen: proximity-based easing combined with a weak snap threshold to avoid surprising jumps when users are making micro-adjustments.

2025-02-22: Tokens: introduce --table-gutter-focus (0.5rem), --table-gutter-magnetic-range (8px), --density-compact-row-height (28px), --density-comfortable-row-height (36px), --density-expanded-row-height (48px). Added motion tokens for collapse/expand (motion-duration-slow: 180ms).

2025-02-25: Accessibility: keyboard-resize uses aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax on column handle; screen reader announcement string pattern: 'Column {name} width {px}, density {state}'. Added note to debounce ARIA updates to avoid flooding SRs during continuous drag.

2025-02-27: Trade-offs: magnetic gutters add small compute for pointer proximity checks; mitigation is to only run proximity checks on pointermove that exceeds 12ms intervals and to fall back to server-side virtualization hints for very wide tables.
2025-03-03: Design review with DCG. Feedback to increase magnetic-range for touch targets and add explicit visual anchors for frozen columns.
comments: 2025-02-14 - Liam Chen (PM): Good alignment on goals. Please include a short video of the prototypes for the sales demo.
2025-02-19 - Sofia Park (Eng): Implementation concern about continuous animation + KV cache invalidation during resize; suggested a 'layout-quiet' mode that delays heavy recompute until pointerup.

notes_for_engineering: Prefer a cheap pointer proximity check and a two-phase resize: 1) visual gutter magnetism and immediate UI feedback (local compositing), 2) deferred heavy layout recompute after pointerup or after 150ms idle. Include feature flag 'magnetic-gutters' for canary rollout. Provide knobs for --table-gutter-magnetic-range and density tokens.
